text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and INR, with mild anemia and abnormal white cell differential. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and hypoxic stress, which may be seen in severe infection (e.g., COVID-19), sepsis, or other critical illness. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are strongly recommended.
